firstFailureClassification.actualStatusRed: The genuine measured artifact is INVALID/verificationPassed false although post-seal verifier and crypto are healthy. This strict criterion remains unchanged.
firstFailureClassification.twoObserverFailures: The initial payload helper read encrypted AMC_BLOB_V files as plaintext JSON. Those two SyntaxError failures are preserved as test observer mistakes, not app defects or killed mutations.
firstFailureClassification.readerCorrection: Only the new payload helper changed to actual loadBlobPlaintext and explicit missing/nonstring path refusal. All behavior assertions remain. The final test records runtime version/executable instead of refusing a future Node24 run.
firstFailureClassification.typeFailure: Root candidate typecheck exit2 reported nullable payload_path at lines52/55. The actual error log is retained; explicit narrowing guard fixes this new helper. Root owns the final typecheck outcome.

actualFinalContract.status: The current production source remains RED on the genuine measured artifact validity criterion. No expectation was weakened to make INVALID acceptable.
actualFinalContract.fixtures: Three actual independently pre-pinned loopback producers each run 13 injection scenarios. Tool-only has 0 measured pass/fail; measured text has 10 pass/3 fail; measured failure has 0 pass/13 fail. The three workspaces contain 165 genuinely signed rows and three session seals.
actualFinalContract.observedBehavior: All tool-report attribution, redacted canonical digests/counts/non-disclosure, ordinary text digests, HIGH audit, real zero-scoring, genuine rows/session/report/v1 signatures, stored hash/seal/status agreement, later verifiers, v1 insufficient/no-findings, tampered-score refusal/exact byte restoration, measured findings and unsigned-local red-team parity pass.
actualFinalContract.statusMeaning: Artifact VALID/INVALID/UNSIGNED is distinct from measurement MEASURED/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and v1 score.status. The proposed fix preserves insufficient measurement and measured failures; VALID refers to healthy artifact verification, not positive grading or regulated eligibility.
actualFinalContract.trustMeaning: Actual OBSERVED/OBSERVED_HARDENED request/reply capture is retained. A controlled loopback target, genuine signatures and independent operator pins do not prove a live model, executed tool, independent regulated evidence or a compliance pass.
